name: KC-46A Pegasus
note: USAF aerial-refuelling tanker/transport based on the Boeing 767-2C. Unarmed. Flight crew of 3 (two pilots + boom operator). Total fuel capacity ~96 t (~212,000 lb), of which ~94,200 lb is transferable. No published combat radius; combatRadiusKm is an on-station estimate.

source.title: No published combat radius (tanker)
source.note: No published radius for a tanker; estimated on-station operating radius ~4,300 km, roughly half the unrefuelled range. Actual radius trades against fuel offloaded.

source.title: Boeing KC-46 Pegasus | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Range: 6,385 nmi (11,830 km) - global with in-flight refuelling'.

source.title: Boeing KC-46 Pegasus | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Cruise speed: 460 kn (851 km/h)'; maximum 500 kn (914 km/h).

source.title: Boeing KC-46 Pegasus | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Capacity: 65,000 lb (29,500 kg)' cargo. Separately, total fuel ~96,297 kg / 31,220 US gal.

source.title: Boeing KC-46 Pegasus | Wikipedia
source.note: Flight crew of 3 (two pilots + boom operator); additional aircrew/aeromedical seats.

name: Il-78 Midas
note: Ilyushin Il-78M aerial-refuelling tanker based on the Il-76MD airlifter. Unarmed. Crew of 6. Il-78M transfers up to 105.7 t of fuel (74 t at 1,000 km; 40 t at 3,000 km). No published combat radius; combatRadiusKm is an estimate.

source.title: No published combat radius (tanker)
source.note: No published radius; estimated ~half the 7,300 km range. On-station offload for the Il-78M is 74 t at 1,000 km and 40 t at 3,000 km.

source.title: Ilyushin Il-78 | Wikipedia
source.note: 'Capacity: Max 100,000 kg payload (fuel)'. The Il-78M can transfer up to 105.7 t total.
